about: Controlled vocabularies for creator.json (read by scripts/creator.py and references/creator-mind.md). Generic: no style, creator or brand names.

principles.concretize_the_abstract: an abstract idea becomes an object or action the viewer already knows
principles.scale_for_magnitude: size, count or distance carries how big a number is
principles.contrast_for_clarity: two states side by side make the difference obvious
principles.show_dont_tell: the picture carries the point so the words do not have to
principles.prove_with_the_real_thing: a claim is backed by the real screen, object or result, not a figure
principles.make_the_invisible_visible: sound, time, data or a feeling is drawn so it can be seen
principles.setup_payoff: something planted early is paid off later
principles.escalate_stakes: each beat raises what is at stake
principles.surprise_resets_attention: an unexpected change wakes the viewer up
principles.open_loop_pulls_forward: an unanswered question keeps the viewer watching
principles.one_idea_per_frame: the frame holds one idea at a time
principles.reveal_in_steps: information is uncovered piece by piece
principles.emotional_mirror: the picture shows the feeling the viewer should have
principles.direct_the_eye: framing, motion or contrast points at the one thing to look at
principles.reduce_to_essentials: everything that does not serve the point is removed
principles.familiar_frame_for_new_idea: a new idea is shown inside a format the viewer already reads
principles.humanize_with_a_face: a face or a person makes the idea relatable
principles.rhythm_on_the_beat: changes land on the music, the breath or the word
principles.silence_for_weight: a pause or dropped sound gives the next moment weight
principles.pace_by_information_density: dense lines get time, light lines move fast
principles.repetition_with_variation: a returning motif changes a little each time
principles.exaggerate_to_clarify: pushing the thing past real life makes the point unmissable
principles.personal_stakes: the viewer sees themselves in the situation
principles.end_on_the_action: the beat ends on the next thing to do
principles.other: none of the above (say which in principle_note)

fit.about: Plausible translation methods per message type. ideate picks its wild card only from these.
